# 1099 income. W2 simplicity.

Every time you get paid, Disco detects it, splits it into spending, taxes, and savings, and shows you exactly where your money should go. No spreadsheets. No guessing.

Disco is an iPhone app that automatically splits 1099 income into spending, tax reserve, and savings. Built for gig workers, freelancers, and the self-employed, Disco connects to your bank, detects each income deposit in real time, and recommends a personalized tax set-aside based on your state and income bracket — so you never get surprised at tax time.

## You earn the money. Nobody helps you manage it.

Nobody withholds your taxes. Nobody splits your paycheck. Nobody tells you what's safe to spend. That changes now.

### "I owe how much?"

Tax season hits and you owe thousands you don't have. Self-employment tax alone is 15.3% — before federal and state income tax.

### "Is this safe to spend?"

You see $3,000 in your account but have no idea how much is earmarked for taxes. So you spend it—and regret it later.

### "I'll figure it out later"

You keep telling yourself you'll set up a system. You never do. Because there's no tool built for how you actually earn.

## Your income, finally organized

Disco connects to your bank, watches for deposits, and instantly tells you how to split every dollar. Personalized to your state, income, and goals.
